```{r}
## import packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpattern)
library(plyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(vegan)
library(cowplot)
```

# ggplot theme setting

```{r}
# plot setting
large <- theme(legend.title = element_text(size=30),
        legend.text = element_text(size=30),
        axis.title = element_text(size=30),
        axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 30),
        axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size=30),
        strip.text = element_text(size=30))
vert_x <- theme(axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face="italic"))
no_strip.x <- theme(strip.background.x = element_blank(),
                  strip.text.x = element_blank())
no_strip.y <- theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
                  strip.text.y = element_blank())
no_legend <- theme(legend.position = "none")

# Standard error function
se <- function(x, ...)sd(x, ...)/sqrt(length(x))

load(file="../Rdata/mis.rda") # Marine Isotope Stage
load(file="../Rdata/spp.rda") # Raw species count
load(file="../Rdata/sam.rda") # Sample information
load(file="../Rdata/div.rda") # Diversity
zero <- rowSums(spp)==0 # The sample with zero count

cluster <- cbind(
  Start = c(4, 200, 832, 1138, 1435),
  End = c(200, 832, 1138, 1434, 1551),
  Period = c(1, 2, 1, 2, 1)
) %>% as.data.frame

cluster <- cbind(Cluster = factor(c("D5", "D4", "D3", "D2", "D1"), levels = c("D5", "D4", "D3", "D2", "D1")), cluster)
```

```{r}
openwater <- c("Actinocyclus curvatulus",	"Actinocyclus ochotensis", 	"Asteromphalus brookei", "Coscinodiscus oculus-iridis", 	"Coscinodiscus tabularis var. egregius", "Rhizosolenia hebetata")
productivity <- c("Chaetoceros sp1",	"Coscinodiscus marginatus",	"Porosira glacialis",	"Shionodiscus trifultus (Thalassiosira trifulta)",	"Thalassiothrix longissima")
seaice <- c("Bacterosira bathyomphala (Bacterosira fragilis)",	"Fragilariopsis cylindrus (Nitzschia cylindra)",	"Thalassiosira antarctica",	"Thalassiosira nordenskioeldii")
periphytic <- c("Chaetoceros septentrionalis",	"Diploneis smithii",	"Melosira sol",	"Paralia sulcata",	"Pseudopodosira elegans",	"Rhaphoneis surirella")
keep <- c(openwater, productivity, seaice, periphytic)
group <- c(rep("OW", 6), rep("PD", 5), rep("SI", 4), rep("PP", 6)) 
dat <- decostand(spp, method = "total", MARGIN = 1, na.rm=TRUE)[, keep]
```

```{r}
dat <- cbind(sam[, c("depth_cm", "Age_ka")], dat) %>% pivot_longer(cols = keep, names_to = "Species")
dat <- cbind(dat[,1:2], "Group" = group[match(dat$Species, keep)], dat[,3:4])
dat$Label <- sub(" ", "~~", paste("italic(", sub(" *\\(.*| *\\var. egregius.*", "", dat$Species), ")", sep="")) 
dat$Group <- factor(dat$Group, levels = c("OW", "PD", "SI", "PP"))
dat$value[is.na(dat$value)]<- 0
dat <- dat %>% group_split(Group)
```


```{r}
# Legend as an independent panel
key.col <- c(OW="#d1aa15", PD="#21918c", SI="#3b528b", PP="#440154")
p <- ggplot(data.frame(Group = names(key.col)), aes(x=NA, y=NA, colour = Group)) +
  geom_line(size = 5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = key.col, breaks = names(key.col), labels=c("Open water", "Productivity", "Sea ice", "Periphytic")) +
  theme_void() %+replace% theme(legend.title = element_text(size=30), legend.text = element_text(size=35), legend.position = "top")
legend_plot <- get_legend(p) %>% ggdraw
```

```{r}
# Top x-axis
  ax2 <- subset(cluster, Period==2)

# Mid-Pleistocene Transition
mpt <- data.frame(xmin = 830, xmax = 1230, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)


p <- lapply(dat, FUN=function(x){
  ggplot()+
    geom_rect_pattern(data= mpt, aes(xmin=xmin, xmax=xmax, ymin=ymin, ymax=ymax), pattern="stripe", pattern_alpha = 0.1, fill="transparent", pattern_density = 0.01, colour="black", linetype = 4)+
    geom_rect(data=ax2, aes(xmin=Start, xmax=End, ymin=-Inf, ymax=Inf), fill="gray", colour="transparent", alpha=0.2)+
  geom_line(data=x, aes(x=Age_ka, y=value*100, colour=Group), alpha = 0.7, linewidth=1.2)+
    labs(x = "Age (ka)", y = "Diatom relative abundance (%)")+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#d1aa15", "#21918c", "#3b528b", "#440154")[as.numeric(x$Group)[1]])+
  scale_x_reverse(expand=expansion(mult = 0.01), breaks=seq(0, 1550, 100), sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*1, breaks = with(cluster, (Start+End)/2), labels = cluster$Cluster))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.01))+
  facet_wrap(~Label, labeller = label_parsed, scales = "free_y", ncol=1)+
  theme_bw()%+replace% large %+replace% vert_x %+replace% theme(legend.position = "none") + guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
}) %>% wrap_plots(ncol=2, nrow =2, guides = "collect", axes = "collect")
```

```{r, fig.height=26, fig.width=20}
legend_plot+p+plot_layout(heights = c(1, 10))
```
